authority.rule: Only the supplied Phase 1 runtime-derived bundle is authoritative for IDs, names, recipes, quantities, prerequisites, unlocks, and acquisition data.

graph_contract.recipe_model: Lossless bipartite hypergraph representation: item -> recipe for inputs; recipe -> item for outputs.
graph_contract.formal_graph: All exact formal_game_data nodes and edges are preserved without flattening.
graph_contract.practical_overlay: The seven Phase 1 practical interpretation edges are retained separately and are not allowed to masquerade as runtime facts.
graph_contract.end_product_scope: Every ItemProto record is indexed as a potential target, including raw resources, buildings, consumables, matrices, combat items, and special/drop items.
graph_contract.dag_definition: The acyclic graph is the strongly connected-component condensation of the lossless directed graph. Cyclic source components remain explicitly inspectable.
graph_contract.alternative_routes: Every producer recipe remains a distinct recipe node; alternative producer routes are never collapsed into a single item-to-item edge.

end_product_dependency_profile.reason_for_exclusions: Absent-resource declarations and capability/unlock-function leaves are retained in the full graph but are not treated as material prerequisites for product closure.

material_production_profile.purpose: Card-authoring and factory-line source of truth. Technology requirements are attached separately so research costs cannot merge otherwise distinct material chains.

formal_research_prerequisite_profile.purpose: Exact explicit and implicit technology prerequisite DAG. Research-input and PreItem gates remain attached as annotations to per-product technology closures.

nodes.description: Cruise/planetary escape and travel to another planet in the starting system.
Reliable titanium ore acquisition beyond incidental sources.
Mining silicon ore directly rather than relying on the 10 stone -> 1 silicon ore fallback.
Automated cargo movement across one planet.
Interstellar warp capability for logistics vessels.

practical_overlay_edges.notes: Drive Engine Lv2 is the practical mobility threshold for leaving the starting planet.
Birth theme has zero titanium vein spots and no recipe produces Titanium Ore; sustained titanium therefore requires access beyond the starter planet.
Birth theme has zero silicon vein spots, but recipe 34 provides a 10 Stone -> 1 Silicon Ore fallback; off-world access is an efficiency/scale gate rather than an absolute silicon gate.
Planetary Logistics System unlocks the station/drone production branch.
Interstellar Logistics System unlocks ILS and Logistics Vessel recipes.
Drive Engine Lv4's prerequisite closure includes Mecha Core Lv4 and Gravitational Wave Refraction.
Logistics Carrier Engine Lv4 has implicit prerequisite Drive Engine Lv4.
